pages.title: Silk Moths
pages.text: Silk Moths live in forests and begin the path to silk equipment. They can also be obtained through $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual#sacrifice)Summoning$(/l), which requires an Athame soul.

pages.title: Behavior
pages.text: Silk Moths are drawn to nearby lights. They also wander and occasionally rest; different varieties can be found in the wild.

pages.title: Breeding
pages.text: Silk Moths can be bred using Fragrant Nectar, which is crafted using the $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/mortar_and_pestle)Mortar and Pestle$(/l).

pages.title: Lifecycle
pages.text: Moths lay Egg Clusters on leaves or Nesting Blocks. Each Cluster yields two Silkworms, which you can place on logs to form cocoons.

pages.title: Cocoons
pages.text: Cocoons can also grow on certain trees. Break one to release a Silkworm, or use a light-emitting block item on it to hatch a Silk Moth.

pages.title: Silk Resources
pages.text: The moth’s lifecycle yields Silk Fiber. Craft it into $(l:hexalia:content/equipment_armor#silkweave)Silkweave$(/l), then use $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/celestial_infusion)Celestial Rituals$(/l) to upgrade Silkweave into $(l:hexalia:content/equipment_armor#moonweave)Moonweave$(/l).
